exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal vs. elective cesarean vs. emergent cesarean)
cohort: All infants born in Canada from 2004 to 2012
finding: While cesarean section (both elective and emergent) was protective against brachial plexus birth injury compared to vaginal delivery, emergent cesarean section was a moderate risk factor compared to elective cesarean section.
mod_finding: Emergent cesarean section was a moderate risk factor for brachial plexus birth injury compared to elective cesarean section.
